summary: Caribou Biosciences filed an 8-K disclosing board-approved restructuring and a strategic-alternatives review on October 2, 2026. The company will discontinue its allogeneic CAR-T programs vispa-cel and CB-011, cut headcount in phases with most departures in Q4 2026, and wind down the ANTLER and CaMMouflage Phase 1 trials. Estimated restructuring charges are $15–$19 million, including $10–$11 million severance benefits and $5–$8 million wind-down costs. No advisor or board recommendation was named. Watch execution and savings.
